sdk_call: client.responses.with_raw_response.create(model, input=[one user message: input_text + (input_text label, input_image) x 64], reasoning, text.format json_schema strict, max_output_tokens, store=false)
service_tier: default/standard (no service_tier parameter sent; returned value recorded)
input_modality: vision: 64 canonical RGB frames + generic text (prompt, frame labels F### | CAM_## | t=s.sssS); no CV state, no compact state
frame_protocol: uniform_total64_v1 via benchmark_v1/scripts/load_model_input.py iter_model_frames(item_id); canonical order kept; frame refs F001..F064 in iteration order

image_transport.data_url: data:image/webp;base64,<...> built in memory; no image files written; base64 payload never stored
image_transport.roundtrip_check: every frame decoded locally after encoding; SHA256(decoded RGB) must equal SHA256(source RGB) or the item fails before any API call
image_transport.choice_note: lossless effort chosen before any benchmark API call from local encode timing only (q50/m2: exact, ~16% smaller than q0/m0, ~1 s/frame single-thread)

api_limits_checked.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/images-vision ('Up to 512 MB total payload per request', 'Up to 1,500 images per request'); gpt-6.1-sol model page (1,050,000 context)

preflight_token_estimate_rule: ESTIMATE ONLY (gpt-6.1-sol not listed in the vision guide): gpt-5.6-sol 'high' rule (fit 2048x2048 and 2,500 32px patches; tokens = ceil(patches*1.2)); provider usage is authoritative for cost

evidence.frame_ref_enum: restricted per request (and per camera for attention/multi) to refs actually supplied

prompt_modality_adaptation.note: P1/P3 decision definitions are reused with CV-state-specific wording replaced by visual wording only (deterministic substitutions in src/visual_prompt_builder.py); categories, level labels/descriptions, risk anchors and thresholds unchanged
prompt_modality_adaptation.confound_disclosed: the possible_scene_or_boundary_entry description drops 'boundary semantics are not known' (true for the CV state, not for frames) and names visible walls/gates/doorways generically, as the P4 base prompt also does

retry_policy: network/timeout errors, HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx only; exponential backoff 1s*2^n + U(0,0.25)s jitter; 4xx and schema failures never retried

failure_policy.refusal: recorded as FAILED (no result file): a schema-valid prediction requires >=1 visual evidence item and a refusal supplies none; nothing is fabricated
failure_policy.preflight_or_roundtrip_failure: item not sent; FAILED; a new transport protocol would be P4-v2

adapter.decision: experiments/p1_decisions/src/decision_adapter.py frozen bytes (thresholds 0.5, confidence formula, priority 0.35/0.30/0.20/0.15, tie-break, human-review rule)
adapter.evidence_text: model-generated observable descriptions keyed by frame_ref; temporal_summary, uncertainties, reason model-generated (short); attention queue / cross-camera texts deterministic templates

pricing.pricing_source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol (Standard: Input $2, Cached input $0.1, Cache writes $2.5, Output $10 per 1M)
